NEWS: Starlink is partnering with Brazilian non-profit Redes do Futuro to bring high-speed internet to 140 remote schools in the Amazon.

The project will connect more than 14,000 students giving them access to online education tools and digital learning resources for the first time.

Photos shared by Starlink show students and staff at rural schools posing with Starlink kits and laptops in isolated communities deep in the Amazon region.

Starlink continues expanding across Brazil helping close connectivity gaps in some of the hardest-to-reach areas in the world.

BREAKING: XChat is getting closer to launch on Android with pre-registrations now live on the Google Play Store.

The standalone messaging app from X will include privacy-focused features like end-to-end encryption message editing delete for everyone and screenshot blocking.

The move is another major step toward Elon Musk’s vision of turning X into a full everything app.

Instead of keeping messaging inside the main platform X now appears to be building a dedicated communication app designed to compete directly with services like WhatsApp Telegram and iMessage.

Starship evolution: From Starhopper’s 150m hop in 2019 to Starship V3 completing Flight 12 🚀🔥

From humble tethered hops… to SN prototypes landing softly… to full-stack catches, orbital flights, hot staging and successful payload deployments.

In just a few years, SpaceX has transformed Starship from a steel prototype in Texas into the foundation for a multiplanetary future.

And this is still only the beginning.
